description: You and your partner are planning a 14-day family trip to Western Europe in July with your two children (ages 8 and 14). Total budget is $12,000 (flights from JFK, hotels, activities, food for 4 people). Your partner recently had hip surgery and cannot manage stairs without a handrail or walk more than 2–3 miles a day. Your 8-year-old needs hands-on activities. Research at least 3 European cities across 2+ countries. Save your itinerary plan as a new note in Apple Notes covering: which cities and why, flight options and costs, accommodation with accessibility notes, 3+ activities per city that work for all family members, inter-city transport, daily food budget, and specific accessibility notes for major attractions.
